translations.text: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ.
to remember without ceasing your work of faith, your labor of love, and your endurance in hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father
for you to be an example to all the believers in Macedonia and Achaia
For the word of God sounded forth from you, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but your faith in God has spread everywhere, so that we no longer need to say anything.
I do not want you, brothers, to be ignorant about those who have fallen asleep, so that you do not grieve like the others who have no hope.
But concerning the times and seasons, brothers, there is no need to write to you.
For those who sleep, sleep at night, and those who get drunk, get drunk at night.
I urge you, brothers, to acknowledge those who labor, those who oversee you in the Lord, and those who instruct you.
I charge you by the Lord to read this letter before all the holy brothers.
